name: browser-history
description: A cross-device browser history synchronization system consisting of a browser extension and a backend server.

scripts.test: bun run test:setup && bun run test:all
scripts.test:all: bun run test:backend && bun run test:extension && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:quick: bun run test:backend:unit && bun run test:extension:unit
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:clean && bun run test:setup && bun run test:all
scripts.test:backend: bun run test:backend:unit && bun run test:backend:integration
scripts.test:extension: bun run test:extension:unit && bun run test:extension:build
scripts.test:extension:unit: echo 'Extension unit tests not yet implemented'
scripts.test:extension:watch: echo 'Extension test watch not yet implemented'
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:extension && playwright test extension-simple.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:headed: bun run build:extension && playwright test extension-simple.spec.ts --headed --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bun run build:extension && playwright test extension-simple.spec.ts --ui
scripts.test:e2e:debug: bun run build:extension && playwright test extension-simple.spec.ts --debug
scripts.test:clean: bun run test:clean:artifacts && bun run test:clean:db
